title: Epigraph
text: Become my helper. Become my human instrument to help me do what I must do on Earth. Leave this empty life you’ve fashioned for yourself, and pledge to me your wits, your courage, your cunning, and your uncommon physical grace. Say that you’re willing, and your life is turned from evil, you confirm it, and you’re at once plunged into the danger and heartache of trying to do what is unquestionably good. —The Angel Malchiah speaking to Toby O’Dare in Angel Time
